operating_goal: One governed decision, consistent application across every applicable producer at its next authorized mutable boundary, proven by executable QA, centrally visible status and no repeated instructions in each chat.
precedence: Explicit user scope, source/LOCKED/currentness protection and safety
Active exact Git-blob-pinned central policy registry and workstream-specific source authority
Source profile's compatible additive, stricter constraints
Historical material solely for replay; later user-verified artifacts supersede stale Git snapshots

global_behavior_contract.dispatch_in_optimizer_chat: For generic continue/resume, prioritize this roadmap and OP-01/OP-02 process work; never pivot to a named content project or do arbitrary lineage audits without an explicit relevant blocker/quality need.
global_behavior_contract.dispatch_in_content_chat: Resolve exact source LATEST and active central registry/profile at every safe new pass; apply only the eligible policy versions, check real output, report HOLD/conflict and update adoption evidence.

required_evidence_per_policy_rollout: The user decision, affected named fields and stages, explicit exclusions, versioned policy path and Git blob
Catalog-derived impact table of expected source owners versus adapters actually tested
Source-specific profile or exception and conflict decisions, never universal schema coercion
Executable positive, negative and false-PASS tests in CI
At least one real output proof per reported ADOPTED producer using actual current portable bytes
Separate immutable source/card/LOCKED checks and Stage4/Stage5/Stage6/Stage7 evidence
Git/Library exact readback when publication is claimed and per-target checkpoint

roadmap.title: Durable cross-chat authority and project steering
roadmap.target: Root bootstraps in both repos, Content Kit active START-PROMPT, Program README and machine-readable roadmap link to one versioned authority; startup/mission guard tests.
roadmap.done_when: Both main branches independently read back exact roadmap pointers and a CI test validates no stage/content promotion.

roadmap.title: Executable single-decision policy propagation and precedence
roadmap.target: Policy change intake → versioned active registry and affected source profiles → ownership graph → testable adapters and fail-closed gates. OP-01 conflict handling and OP-02 production workflow are the controlling work packages.
roadmap.done_when: A named policy change has source/version pins, real adapter hooks, Git CI positive and negative tests, impact matrix and no unsupported ADOPTED labels.

roadmap.title: Real producer conformance and source-type profiles
roadmap.target: Verify actual A1/A2/B1, Aspekte, Grammar, 250 Verben, NVV and Vocabulary native exports, where appropriate; separate lexical, grammar, text and source-authority variations.
roadmap.done_when: Each applicable producer and consumer has exact real-output SHA/typed schema checks and a status of tested/pending/conflict. Known B1 L19 malformed details remain a blocker until its own authorized workstream fixes it.

roadmap.title: Reliable whole-program Control Center dashboard
roadmap.target: Aggregate 21 families / 34 workspaces / 17 root keys with exact live Git/LATEST/Library evidence, stage boundaries, HOLDs, owner, latest actual byte proof, remaining and next action.
roadmap.done_when: Dashboard distinguishes navigation from verified data, supersession from CURRENT, Stage4 linguistic from Stage5/6/7; reports stale/missing evidence as HOLD rather than inventing PASS.

roadmap.title: Parallel orchestration and conflict-free publication
roadmap.target: Per-workstream single-writer/CAS, exact expected parent SHA, Git branch/PR workflow, test gates and readback; separate content writers and independent workstreams.
roadmap.done_when: A stale writer cannot overwrite a newer successor, all applicable paths have enforced guards, protection limitations stated explicitly, no universal auto-edit claim.

roadmap.title: Reproducible release and efficient Library lifecycle
roadmap.target: One organized release ZIP containing App, Content, Source, Tests, Reports, Docs and Tools/Launcher; manifest, SHA, no unnecessary duplicates; deletion only on explicit authorization.
roadmap.done_when: One source-bound reproducible release with real readback, scope-specific Stage pass and safe retention policy; no automatic deletion.

roadmap.title: Measured progressive adoption and continuous regression
roadmap.target: Batch policy rollout by consumer eligibility and workstream boundary, monitor coverage, quality defects, hours saved and cross-source regressions.
roadmap.done_when: Report exact covered versus applicable producers for each policy; add CI checks and visible next owners, never blanket 34/34 from metadata-only routing.

immediate_next_action: Implement P1 as a scoped executable policy-to-producer conformance gate and per-producer adoption evidence (prefer no card edits), not another Aber Hallo historical ZIP lineage expansion.
explicit_non_goals: Creating or editing flashcards from a generic optimization continue
Rewriting original PDFs or any LOCKED historic data
Assuming all chats are live synchronized with Git changes
Claiming Stage4–7, browser/IndexedDB, CURRENT or FINAL from metadata-only CI
Significant UI/UX changes without user approval
Deleting Library material without explicit consent
proof_boundary: This artifact makes the roadmap discoverable at startup; it does not magically implement or propagate future policy to existing open chats, all producers, or protected branches.
ownership: Content Kit is policy/roadmap authority; app repository is a consumer; each workstream retains exact artifact and Stage authority.
